review_notes.source_review: All 35 native gate fields, printed pins, routes, cables and footer reviewed. CG is the native ID of the 1K block. The central third rail has a visible row56 gap: ROS+FLT joins AT.D10/AV.D05 above it, RELEASE feeds AW.B08 below it. GAP passes the foreign AV.D05 point without a native diamond; ROS+FLT passes BW.D04 similarly. ROS6 rises on the separate leftmost rail to AZ.B10. No implicit joins were inserted.
